companies.name: Rescana
companies.description: Autonomous supply chain cyber risk management. Rescana is the first fully autonomous third-party risk management platform, built to replace slow, manual, and error-prone legacy TPRM processes. Instead of overwhelming teams with noisy data and false positives, Rescana uses specialized AI agents to automatically discover vendors, assess risk, and drive remediation end to end. The platform scales effortlessly, allowing teams to handle up to five times more vendors without adding headcount. With a simple three-step workflow - classify, assess, remediate - Rescana keeps risk teams focused on what actually matters. The result is faster vendor onboarding, clearer risk posture, and measurable operational impact

companies.name: Plenti
companies.description: Consumer electronics rental marketplace. Plenti gives people affordable, flexible access to premium technology without the need to own it. Customers subscribe to smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, and other devices for a monthly fee, with the option to upgrade, return, or switch over time. On the supply side, Plenti works with partners through asset-light financing structures that turn devices into recurring revenue streams. The platform combines proprietary risk and pricing models with circular logistics to extend product lifecycles and improve unit economics. Plenti generates revenue through subscriptions, partner fees, and lifecycle services, and is preparing for expansion into the U.S. market

companies.name: Mycroft

From SOC 2 compliance to TPRM and IT Operations and beyond - it's the singular platform that helps scaling companies build enterprise grade cybersecurity without the additional overhead
companies.team: Mike Kim (Co-Founder & CEO), Jan Jedrasik (Co-Founder & Head of Engineering)

companies.name: Scobic
companies.description: Zero-emissions light electric vehicles for last-mile deliveries. SCOOBIC is a Spanish cleantech company that designs and manufactures light electric vehicles and sustainable last mile mobility. As e-commerce and on demand delivery strain urban logistics, SCOOBIC tackles the problem with zero emission vehicles, swappable batteries, and an integrated mobility, energy, and data layer that increases number of deliveries per hour and the profitability of logistics. Its platform brings IoT telemetry, predictive maintenance, and analytics to orchestrate vehicles and charging while reducing total cost of ownership. The roadmap advances next generation vehicles and energy hubs to support data driven logistics ecosystems
companies.team: José Enrique Díaz Buzón (Co-Founder), Pere Serrat (US Business Development)

companies.name: NeuronUP
companies.description: AI-powered platform for cognitive rehabilitation and neuropsychological assessment. Digital health B2B SaaS focused on improving cognitive rehabilitation and neuropsychological assessment worldwide. The platform addresses the growing need for scalable, evidence-based solutions in rehabilitation centers, hospitals, care homes, neuroclinics, and healthcare networks in over 50 countries

companies.name: Madup
companies.description: AI marketing agent for autonomous ad campaigns. Madup Inc. is the company behind LEVER Xpert, a digital marketing AI agent designed to help brands operate and optimize advertising at scale. LEVER functions as an AI digital marketer, analyzing performance data across media, creative, and audience signals to support faster and more informed marketing decisions. The platform is trained on real execution data derived from over $1B in cumulative advertising spend, along with expertise from global beauty, fashion, and CPG brands

We enable individuals to control and earn from their data, while providing businesses with high-quality, real-world datasets that power faster, smarter decision-making. Our core differentiation is depth, consent, and accuracy: real user behaviour, captured continuously, at scale

companies.name: Decidr
companies.description: AI operating system for enterprise decision-making. DecidrOS addresses the growing challenge organisations face in scaling AI beyond fragmented, experimental use into governed, outcome-driven operations. Our agentic operating system makes organisational knowledge explicit, normalises enterprise data for AI, and orchestrates human and AI agents through a deterministic control layer for decision making and execution. Unlike point solutions that automate isolated tasks, DecidrOS provides a unified platform to design, coordinate, and manage AI-driven work across the organisation. The platform continuously adapts to changing conditions, enabling organisations to become more intelligent, resilient, and scalable over time. DecidrOS is offered as an enterprise SaaS platform, allowing organisations to deploy, govern, and scale agentic operations securely

companies.name: Trendtracker
companies.description: AI-powered trend intelligence and strategic foresight. Trendtracker is an enterprise-grade strategic intelligence platform that acts as your strategy partner, continuously scanning billions of data points and delivering real-time insights tailored to your geography, market, and priorities. By surfacing weak signals, forecasting trend evolution, and providing actionable recommendations, it turns months of research into minutes. Its industry-agnostic approach brings valuable perspectives from adjacent sectors, helping insurers anticipate disruptions, identify opportunities, and make smarter decisions with confidence
